title: melandrium terminale
intro: Melandrium terminale, commonly known as Alpine Balsam or Alpine Rose, is a type of flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Melandrium terminale include reducing inflammation, fighting against oxidative stress, and possessing antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
